accounts.description: Specific accounts to sync. Must be populated if `sync_mode` is set to `SpecificAccounts`.

sync_mode.description: Whether to sync all accounts or specific accounts. Default value: `AllAccounts`.

timeframe_months.description: Number of months' worth of data you'd like to include in your initial sync. This cannot be modified once the connector is created. Default value: `SIX`.

schema.title: Destination schema name
schema.description: Destination schema name. Schema name is permanent and cannot be changed after connection creation

access_token.description: The `Access Token` carries the information necessary for API resources to fetch data

client_id.description: `Client ID` of your Facebook client application.

client_secret.description: `Client Secret` of your Facebook client application.
